direction_policy.default: current live aim; movement facing fallback; south final fallback
direction_policy.slide: current nontrivial planar velocity; retained slide vector; movement facing fallback; never cursor aim
direction_policy.crouch: live aim while stationary; moving crouch needs independent lower-body travel
direction_policy.walk_and_sprint: all 8 travel x 8 aim combinations; lower-body contacts follow travel, upper body follows aim
direction_policy.wallrun: proposed body tangent follows accepted wallrun vector, near-wall side follows wall normal; aim remains separate
direction_policy.roll_air_dodge_wavedash: proposed body follows admitted travel lane, hand cast overlay follows live aim; do not silently change simulation vectors
direction_policy.airborne: aim torso plus velocity-oriented lower body; air turns update immediately without restarting phase
direction_policy.turn_blending: no crossfade between adjacent directional cells; secondary motion must not delay facing
direction_policy.authoring_gate: front, three-quarter, profile and back views visually distinct; assigning direction metadata alone does not certify true yaw

clock_policy.preview_fps: fallback only for isolated art viewer; never replace action clocks
clock_policy.cast: startup from pending_cast_ticks and CombatTuning.cast_definition; recovery from cast_recovery_ticks; independent overlay cannot freeze locomotion
clock_policy.protection: MovementSystem.is_combat_intangible and height clearance remain separate from sprite pose

airborne_policy.ground_anchor: shadow, landing and takeoff effects stay at ground anchor
airborne_policy.interpolation: previous accepted air_height only; maximum interpolation step 32000 fixed units
airborne_policy.nonflight: one paid double jump instead of flight; art existence must never grant flight capability
airborne_policy.wallrun: does not grant blanket airborne damage immunity; follow authoritative height/protection flags

acceptance: Per-character, per-action and per-direction provenance; count an animation only when visually distinct authored motion exists.
Walk and sprint feet alternate support, pass and contact; whole-sprite translation alone is not a gait.
All eight slide directions show bent limbs and committed travel, not a rotated upright idle.
Independent aim/travel coverage must be demonstrated for moving casts, including backwards and lateral travel.
No clipped wings, tails, horns or toes; actual body-core proportion checks exclude decorative extremities.
Consistent anatomical lengths and one feet pivot across action changes; no frame-wise stretch or rescale.
Native art-gallery captures and actual live-game capture are separate gates; neither is human acceptance.
Art-only coverage does not activate unsupported abilities or change network/simulation contracts.
